scope: Condition 1 baseline only; all metrics are passive and never feed control.

foraging_episode.definition: one Scout-local lifecycle from SCOUT_START/NEXT_CYCLE_START to DELIVER or global horizon

return_episode.definition: each RETURN_HOME_START, with geometric progress measured passively from trajectory

nest_energy.definition: gross deliveries, robot recharge withdrawals, and resulting net Nest Energy are separate quantities; mission target applies only to net Nest Energy

robot_internal_energy.definition: per-Scout internal energy from common executed-motion cost, with depletion and Nest recharge recorded

mission_outcome.definition: MISSION_SUCCESS iff net_nest_energy >= nest_energy_target; otherwise TIME_LIMIT_REACHED at global horizon

cycle_delivery.definition: started/completed Scout cycles and lifecycle event counts; legacy trip count never terminates research mode

net_energy_rate.unit: net Nest Energy per 1000 simulated seconds

repetition.definition: revisited 0.5 m cells and repeated local action labels; not controller input
